blurb: Blades Golf Lounge offers indoor golf using Foresight Falcon technology, the same simulators trusted by PGA, LPGA, and LIV pros. Members have 24/7 access to the facility with the ability to book tee times via an online system. The lounge features a retro-modern aesthetic and allows guests to bring up to 3 guests for free during pay-as-you-go sessions.
extraNote: Pay as you go available 8 AM – 11 PM, tee times in 60-minute increments, up to 3-hour tee times · Members receive unique access code via text for 24/7 entry · Camel Central Plaza, Uptown Phoenix
